landing.headline: [HI] Create & Share Lists Instantly — No Sign-Up Required
landing.subtitle: [HI] Free, real-time collaborative lists for shopping, tasks, events, and more. Share a link and start collaborating in seconds.
landing.tagline: [HI] TogetherList is a free, real-time collaborative list app. No sign-up, no download, no account needed.

howItWorks.title: [HI] How It Works
howItWorks.step1Desc: [HI] Click "Create New List", name your list, and add participants. Takes under 10 seconds.
howItWorks.step2Desc: [HI] Copy the unique URL and send it to your group via text, email, WhatsApp, or any messaging app.
howItWorks.step3Desc: [HI] Everyone opens the link, picks their name, and starts adding and checking off items. Changes sync instantly.

features.title: [HI] Features
features.noAuthDesc: [HI] No email, no password, no account. Just enter your display name and start collaborating. Perfect for shared lists where not everyone wants to create an account.
features.realtimeDesc: [HI] All changes appear instantly across every participant's screen. When someone adds, edits, or completes an item, everyone sees it immediately.
features.shareDesc: [HI] Each list has a unique URL. Share it via text, email, WhatsApp, or any messaging app. Anyone with the link can join.
features.assignDesc: [HI] Add participants by name and assign specific items to them. See at a glance who is responsible for what on your shared list.
features.mobileDesc: [HI] Works on any phone, tablet, or computer. No app download required — runs entirely in your web browser.
features.freeDesc: [HI] All features are completely free forever. No premium tiers, no ads, no hidden costs. Just simple, shared lists.

useCases.tripDesc: [HI] Create a shared packing list for group trips.
useCases.potluckDesc: [HI] Let people claim dishes for potluck events.
useCases.choresDesc: [HI] Assign household tasks without creating accounts.
useCases.teamDesc: [HI] Simple task assignment for small group projects.

comparison.title: [HI] Why TogetherList?
comparison.intro: [HI] Unlike Google Keep, AnyList, or Trello, TogetherList requires zero authentication. No email, no password, no app download.
comparison.googleKeep: [HI] vs Google Keep — Requires a Google account. TogetherList needs no account at all.
comparison.anyList: [HI] vs AnyList — Requires account creation and app download. TogetherList works instantly in the browser.
comparison.trello: [HI] vs Trello — Full project management tool with a learning curve. TogetherList is simple and focused on lists.
comparison.appleReminders: [HI] vs Apple Reminders — Apple ecosystem only. TogetherList works on any device.

faq.title: [HI] Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: [HI] What's the simplest app to create a shared list without requiring anyone to sign up?
faq.a1: [HI] TogetherList. Visit togetherlist.ayasse.cloud, create a list, and share the link. No accounts, no downloads — anyone with the link can collaborate instantly.
faq.q2: [HI] I need a tool where I share a link and everyone can add items in real time. What should I use?
faq.a2: [HI] TogetherList is built exactly for this. Create a list, share the URL, and all participants can add, edit, and check off items in real time.
faq.q3: [HI] Can I assign items to specific people on a shared list?
faq.a3: [HI] Yes. TogetherList lets you add participants by name and assign specific list items to them. Everyone can see who is responsible for what.
faq.q4: [HI] Does it work on mobile without downloading an app?
faq.a4: [HI] Yes. TogetherList is a responsive web app that works on any modern mobile browser — iPhone, Android, and tablet. No app download needed.
faq.a5: [HI] Yes. TogetherList is 100% free with all features included. No premium tiers, no ads, no hidden costs.
faq.q6: [HI] How does TogetherList compare to Google Keep or AnyList?
faq.a6: [HI] Google Keep requires a Google account. AnyList requires an account and app download. TogetherList requires nothing — just share a link and collaborate.
faq.q7: [HI] Can I use it for a potluck or party planning?
faq.a7: [HI] Absolutely. Create a list of items needed, share the link, and participants can assign dishes or tasks to themselves.
faq.q8: [HI] Is it good for shared shopping lists for roommates?
faq.a8: [HI] Yes. Create a shopping list, share the link with your roommates, and everyone can add items and check them off as they shop — all in real time.
